stories.title: Council warned an oxygen crash is coming at Buckley pond and little can be done
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has been warned that oxygen levels in Higher Common Pond in Buckley could crash, with little that can be done in the short term to stop it. stories.title: Body of lurcher found dumped at Higher Kinnerton had two previous owners in north Wales
stories.summary: The RSPCA is trying to trace the last owner of a black lurcher whose body was found dumped on a verge at Higher Kinnerton. stories.title: NHS treatment waiting list rises for third month in a row in Wales
stories.summary: The number of NHS treatment waiting-list pathways in Wales has risen for the third month in a row. New figures released by the Welsh Government show that in June there were just under 698,400 referral to treatment (RTT) patient pathways waiting to start treatment, an increase of around 8,700 since May. stories.summary: Flintshire has the third highest number of people in prison of any council area in Wales, new government figures show. stories.title: Dispersal order in place in Chester from 7pm tonight ahead of Saturday race day
stories.summary: Police will be able to order people out of Chester city centre for up to 48 hours this weekend, under powers that come into force at 7pm tonight.
